title: Line sketch: Split Sun Mask
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A vertically divided stylized face with tribal features occupies the center, featuring cheek and forehead dots, outlines, and leaf-like protrusions against a flat sage- background with a sun. The composition is symmetrical yet bisected, using bold flat shapes and clean lines for graphic impact. Technique employs solid color fields and minimal shading for a modern illustrative effect (derived from painting #162).
